plan: A forge god tank who knocks his target up and upgrades his team's items.
aSurveiller: His R (Call of the Forge God). A lava ram comes back towards him and knocks up: step out of its path.
contrer: Stay away from walls: his E stuns you there.
Step out of the path of his R: he recasts it to knock up.
Percent health damage is effective against him.
faiblesses: Relies on walls for some combos.

sorts.P: Boosts his resistances and can forge items.
sorts.W: Fire breath that makes enemies brittle.
sorts.E: Charge that stuns against a wall.
sorts.R: Elemental that comes back and knocks up.

momentFort: Useful all game, very strong in team fights.
